high_level_description: The image depicts the successful launch of the Agnibaan SoRTed-01 mission by AgniKul Cosmos from their launch pad at SDSC-SHAR (Satish Dhawan Space Centre-South) in Sriharikota. The text overlay provides context, highlighting that this is a major milestone as it marks the first-ever controlled flight of a semi-cryogenic liquid engine realized through additive manufacturing.
